description: Explicit tabulated Swiss Ephemeris osculating ascending lunar node, not an independent lunar theory

source_join_velocity_reconstruction.method: Four neighboring safe quarter-day velocity samples, cubic interpolation at center; positions remain unmodified

interpolation: Four-point cubic Lagrange, independently for each observable
limitations: Swiss lunar Chebyshev segment joins can have position discontinuities and narrow finite-difference velocity spikes; this smooth interpolant does not reproduce such spikes
format: little-endian f64 [unwrapped longitude deg, speed deg/day, distance AU, speed AU/day]
